svg.title: Figure 26.1 · The loss rewards a leaking mask
svg.desc: Two training curves on random ids. The committed model stays at ln 64 = 4.159, the best any honest model can do. The same model with its causal mask removed falls to 0.218 by step 200, because each position can read the id it is asked to predict.
